decisions.what: Added aria-label='Main navigation' to the primary nav element
decisions.why: Spec required aria-label attributes on navigation landmarks for screen reader accessibility

decisions.what: Added aria-label attributes to all nav links in desktop nav, mobile nav, and footer nav columns
decisions.why: Spec required aria-label like 'Navigate to gallery section' on navigation links to provide descriptive context for screen readers

decisions.what: Added leading-tight to h2 headings in gallery, story, newsletter sections that were missing it
decisions.why: Spec required leading-tight for large headlines to refine typography hierarchy consistently

decisions.what: Added tracking-tight to h2 headings in gallery, story, newsletter sections
decisions.why: Spec required tracking-tight for large headlines to refine letter-spacing throughout the typography hierarchy

decisions.what: Added leading-relaxed to body paragraphs in hero, story, footer, and newsletter sections
decisions.why: Spec required leading-relaxed for body text to ensure appropriate line-height for readability

decisions.what: Enhanced image alt text across gallery and story sections to be more descriptive
decisions.why: Spec required enhanced alt text on all images for better screen reader accessibility and WCAG AA compliance

decisions.what: Wrapped footer social links div in a nav element with aria-label='Footer social media links'
decisions.why: Provides semantic navigation landmark for screen readers to identify the footer social media links region

decisions.what: Added aria-label to CTA anchor links (View All Pieces, Join the Movement)
decisions.why: Spec required accessible labels on interactive elements where additional context improves screen reader experience

decisions.what: Added Features Implemented, Accessibility, Performance, Browser Support, and Credits sections to README
decisions.why: Spec required all these sections to document the completed project comprehensively

decisions.what: Updated Project Structure in README to reflect actual file structure (removed non-existent assets/ directory)
decisions.why: The actual project has index.html, app.js, .gitignore, README.md at root; the previous README listed a hypothetical assets/ directory

decisions.what: Updated Deployment section in README with note about automated GitHub Actions workflow
decisions.why: Spec required noting that the site is already deployed via workflow
